name: Tail
description: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target not grappled by the beast. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 16 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.
